summary.name: Sticker Collage (Printmaking and Craft Materials category; label normalized from source descriptions).
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: consistent white sticker borders and light contact shadows on paper, notebook pages or a simple surface. Stickers are placed, peeled and slightly rotated at uniform cutout quality and border scale. Stickers must not float without surface contact.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: playful arrangements of existing subjects. Choose a hybrid when stickers need drawn characters or connecting notes. Inferred: suits casual, craft-led or illustrative topics. Avoid pairing with sticker-explainer styles, which duplicate its look.
summary.limitations: Explicit: keep white border width and sticker scale constant, and do not roughen every cutout edge. Optional tools such as Rough.js, mo.js, Matter.js and 3D paper curl need a specific authorized need. Source review covered only seconds 1–8 at one frame per second, so no continuous motion or audio was verified.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent, chosen from subject, mood and lighting; the policy is not a fixed canvas colour. Illustrative, unapproved swatches: background #F3EBD9, foreground #273F49, white border #FFFFFF, accents #D78267 and #77A397. Gradients are disabled. Foreground on background (9.346) and on white (11.091) meet text targets; both accents are decorative only (3.844, 3.945). Reference examples used flat per-scene fields with white borders and one emphasis accent; their hues are not style constants. Task-approved exact colors override these and must not be recoloured.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: placing, peeling, lifting and slight rotation through layer transforms, plus repeated arrangements. Optional motion references: motion-012 chapter handoff, motion-015 narrative steps, motion-037 letter stickers lifting before replacement, and motion-038 punctuation sticker zoom. Use them only when scene assets support the action. Video is driven by composition time. Combination guidance suggests hover or focus lift only for interactive HTML stickers.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style; no mandatory audio layer is assigned. Guidance: propose music, voiceover, effects, ambience or silence from topic, audience and objective, honouring any explicit user choice. Do not default silently to instrumental music. Inferred: restrained placement sounds or silence could mark reading holds. No audio was verified in the reviewed sources.
summary.assetRequirements: No assets are mandated and none were supplied. The style needs cutout sticker or subject assets with alpha masks, expanded to produce uniform white borders and shadows, plus a paper, notebook or simple surface. Motion-037 and -038 need the actual phrase letters or punctuation mark. Fonts must be loaded locally. Aspect ratio and duration are unspecified.
summary.combinations: Style-025 (doodle characters) gives sticker subjects personality. Keep border width constant, use foreground ink for linework, limit fills to coral and sage, and avoid floating stickers. Style-024 (notebook annotations) adds short arrows and notes on paper, never on borders, in foreground ink with coral emphasis. Avoid sticker-explainer styles.
summary.productionApproach: Default pipeline: HyperFrames, using a paused GSAP timeline registered per composition, then check, snapshot and render. Remotion is a fallback only for a verified limitation. Style renderer: SVG primary, PixiJS for large sprite sets, Rough.js for optional sketch interiors. Motion: Motion, or mo.js for restrained entrance accents. Use procedural paper curl only when depth is needed. Pillow or Sharp prepare alpha masks; chroma.js checks composited contrast; Matter.js only for precomputed settling. Verify decoded frames and direct seeks.
